name: L0 总体审核入口
description: 制作人（L0）总体审核入口，一键发起全面审核，自动收集进度和问题
author: Pipeline-Sys

chapter_ids.description: 章节 ID（逗号分隔，scope=chapter时使用）

auto_trigger_missing.description: 是否自动触发缺失的审查

project_root.description: 项目根目录（由调用方提供）

nodes.name: 参数接收
nodes.expression: ({ audit_id: 'AUDIT-' + new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10).replace(/-/g,'') + '-' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,6).toUpperCase(), scope: inputs.audit_scope, started_at: new Date().toISOString(), period: { start: new Date(Date.now() - inputs.period_days * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString().slice(0, 10), end: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10) } })

nodes.name: 扫描待审查项
nodes.description: 扫描所有待审查的任务和文档
nodes.command: echo '=== 扫描待审查项 ===' && mkdir -p workflows/project/logs/reviews && echo "TASKPACKS_COUNT=$(find design/ai-native/03_taskpacks -name '*.md' -mtime -${inputs.period_days} 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" && echo 'TASKPACKS_SAMPLE_BEGIN' && find design/ai-native/03_taskpacks -name '*.md' -mtime -${inputs.period_days} 2>/dev/null | sort | head -20 && echo 'TASKPACKS_SAMPLE_END' && echo "SPECS_COUNT=$(find design/ai-native/02_specs -name '*.md' -mtime -${inputs.period_days} 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" && echo 'SPECS_SAMPLE_BEGIN' && find design/ai-native/02_specs -name '*.md' -mtime -${inputs.period_days} 2>/dev/null | sort | head -20 && echo 'SPECS_SAMPLE_END' && echo "COMMITS_COUNT=$(git log --oneline --since='${inputs.period_days} days ago' 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" && echo 'COMMITS_SAMPLE_BEGIN' && git log --oneline --since='${inputs.period_days} days ago' 2>/dev/null | head -20 && echo 'COMMITS_SAMPLE_END' && echo "REVIEWS_COUNT=$(find workflows/project/logs/reviews -name '*.json' -mtime -${inputs.period_days} 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" && echo 'REVIEWS_SAMPLE_BEGIN' && find workflows/project/logs/reviews -name '*.json' -mtime -${inputs.period_days} 2>/dev/null | sort | head -20 && echo 'REVIEWS_SAMPLE_END'

nodes.name: 解析扫描结果
nodes.expression: (function() { const output = nodes.scan_pending_items.output.stdout || ''; const getInt = (key) => { const m = output.match(new RegExp('^' + key + '=(\\d+)\\s*$', 'm')); return m ? parseInt(m[1], 10) : 0; }; const getBlock = (start, end) => { const re = new RegExp(start + '\\n([\\s\\S]*?)\\n' + end); const m = output.match(re); if (!m) return []; return m[1].split('\\n').map(l => l.trim()).filter(Boolean); }; const taskpacks = getInt('TASKPACKS_COUNT'); const specs = getInt('SPECS_COUNT'); const commits = getInt('COMMITS_COUNT'); const reviews = getInt('REVIEWS_COUNT'); const samples = { taskpacks: getBlock('TASKPACKS_SAMPLE_BEGIN', 'TASKPACKS_SAMPLE_END'), specs: getBlock('SPECS_SAMPLE_BEGIN', 'SPECS_SAMPLE_END'), commits: getBlock('COMMITS_SAMPLE_BEGIN', 'COMMITS_SAMPLE_END'), reviews: getBlock('REVIEWS_SAMPLE_BEGIN', 'REVIEWS_SAMPLE_END') }; return { pending: { taskpacks, specs, commits }, existing_reviews: reviews, samples, needs_code_review: commits > reviews, needs_design_review: specs > 0, needs_qa_signoff: taskpacks > 0 }; })()

nodes.name: 检查是否需要触发审查
批量触发审查（占位）
nodes.description: 自动触发缺失的审查流程
nodes.command: echo '自动触发审查已禁用，跳过...' && echo 'code_review_triggered=0' && echo 'design_review_triggered=0'

nodes.name: 收集现有审查记录
nodes.command: mkdir -p workflows/project/logs/reviews && for f in workflows/project/logs/reviews/*.json; do [ -f "$f" ] && cat "$f" && echo '|||'; done | head -50000

nodes.name: 汇总审查数据
nodes.expression: (function() { const output = nodes.collect_existing_reviews.output.stdout || ''; const parts = output.split('|||').filter(p => p.trim()); const reviews = []; parts.forEach(p => { try { const obj = JSON.parse(p.trim()); if (obj && (obj.review_id || obj.signoff_id || obj.acceptance_id)) { reviews.push(obj); } } catch(e) {} }); const crs = reviews.filter(r => r.review_id && r.review_id.startsWith('CR-')); const drs = reviews.filter(r => r.review_id && r.review_id.startsWith('DR-')); const qas = reviews.filter(r => r.signoff_id && r.signoff_id.startsWith('QA-')); return { code_reviews: { count: crs.length, passed: crs.filter(r => r.result === 'APPROVED').length, avg_score: crs.length > 0 ? Math.round(crs.reduce((s, r) => s + (r.score || 0), 0) / crs.length) : 0 }, design_reviews: { count: drs.length, passed: drs.filter(r => r.result === 'APPROVED').length, avg_score: drs.length > 0 ? Math.round(drs.reduce((s, r) => s + (r.score || 0), 0) / drs.length) : 0 }, qa_signoffs: { count: qas.length, passed: qas.filter(r => r.result === 'PASSED' || r.result === 'PARTIAL').length }, all_reviews: reviews }; })()

nodes.name: 收集问题清单
nodes.expression: (function() { const reviews = nodes.aggregate_reviews.output.all_reviews || []; const blockers = []; const warnings = []; const improvements = []; reviews.forEach(r => { if (r.result === 'REJECTED' || r.result === 'FAILED') { blockers.push({ source: r.review_id || r.signoff_id, target: r.task_id || r.doc_path, issues: r.issues || r.blocking_issues || [] }); } else if (r.result === 'CHANGES_REQUESTED' || r.result === 'REVISION_REQUIRED') { warnings.push({ source: r.review_id || r.signoff_id, target: r.task_id || r.doc_path, issues: r.issues || [] }); } if (r.suggestions) { improvements.push(...r.suggestions); } }); return { blockers, warnings, improvements: [...new Set(improvements)], blocker_count: blockers.length, warning_count: warnings.length }; })()

nodes.name: 生成进度报告
nodes.expression: (function() { const agg = nodes.aggregate_reviews.output; const scan = nodes.parse_scan_results.output; const totalReviews = agg.code_reviews.count + agg.design_reviews.count + agg.qa_signoffs.count; const passedReviews = agg.code_reviews.passed + agg.design_reviews.passed + agg.qa_signoffs.passed; const overallRate = totalReviews > 0 ? Math.round((passedReviews / totalReviews) * 100) : 100; return { type: 'progress', audit_id: nodes.intake.output.audit_id, period: nodes.intake.output.period, metrics: { tasks_in_period: scan.pending.taskpacks, specs_in_period: scan.pending.specs, commits_in_period: scan.pending.commits, reviews_completed: totalReviews, reviews_passed: passedReviews, overall_pass_rate: overallRate + '%', code_review_avg_score: agg.code_reviews.avg_score, design_review_avg_score: agg.design_reviews.avg_score }, breakdown: { code_review: agg.code_reviews, design_review: agg.design_reviews, qa_signoff: agg.qa_signoffs }, status: overallRate >= 80 ? 'HEALTHY' : (overallRate >= 60 ? 'WARNING' : 'CRITICAL') }; })()

nodes.name: 生成问题报告
nodes.expression: ({ type: 'issues', audit_id: nodes.intake.output.audit_id, period: nodes.intake.output.period, summary: { blocker_count: nodes.collect_issues.output.blocker_count, warning_count: nodes.collect_issues.output.warning_count, improvement_count: nodes.collect_issues.output.improvements.length }, blockers: nodes.collect_issues.output.blockers, warnings: nodes.collect_issues.output.warnings, improvements: nodes.collect_issues.output.improvements, priority_actions: nodes.collect_issues.output.blocker_count > 0 ? ['优先解决阻塞问题'] : (nodes.collect_issues.output.warning_count > 0 ? ['处理警告问题'] : ['维持现状']) })

nodes.name: 生成决策建议
nodes.expression: (function() { const progress = nodes.generate_progress_report.output; const issues = nodes.generate_issue_report.output; const recommendations = []; if (issues.summary.blocker_count > 0) { recommendations.push('🔴 存在 ' + issues.summary.blocker_count + ' 个阻塞问题，建议暂停新开发，优先修复'); } if (issues.summary.warning_count > 5) { recommendations.push('🟡 警告问题较多（' + issues.summary.warning_count + '个），建议安排专项修复'); } if (progress.metrics.code_review_avg_score < 70) { recommendations.push('⚠️ 代码审查平均分较低（' + progress.metrics.code_review_avg_score + '），建议加强代码规范培训'); } if (progress.status === 'HEALTHY') { recommendations.push('✅ 整体健康，可以继续推进'); } const nextSteps = []; if (issues.summary.blocker_count > 0) { nextSteps.push('修复阻塞问题'); } if (progress.metrics.reviews_completed < progress.metrics.commits_in_period) { nextSteps.push('补充缺失的代码审查'); } nextSteps.push('定期复查进度'); return { decision: progress.status === 'HEALTHY' ? 'PROCEED' : (progress.status === 'WARNING' ? 'PROCEED_WITH_CAUTION' : 'HOLD'), recommendations, next_steps: nextSteps }; })()

nodes.name: 汇总最终报告
nodes.expression: ({ audit_id: nodes.intake.output.audit_id, scope: inputs.audit_scope, requester: inputs.requester, period: nodes.intake.output.period, scan_summary: nodes.parse_scan_results.output, progress_report: nodes.generate_progress_report.output, issue_report: nodes.generate_issue_report.output, recommendations: nodes.generate_recommendations.output, completed_at: new Date().toISOString() })

nodes.name: 构建进度报告 Markdown
nodes.expression: (function() { const auditId = nodes.intake.output.audit_id; const period = nodes.intake.output.period; const now = new Date().toISOString(); const progress = nodes.generate_progress_report.output; const rec = nodes.generate_recommendations.output; const scan = nodes.parse_scan_results.output || { pending: { taskpacks: 0, specs: 0, commits: 0 }, existing_reviews: 0, samples: {} }; const samples = scan.samples || {}; const fmtList = (items, emptyText = '- （无）') => { const list = (items || []).map(s => String(s).trim()).filter(Boolean).slice(0, 20); if (!list.length) return emptyText; return list.map(s => '- ' + s).join('\n'); }; const md = [ '# 进度报告', '', `> 审核ID: ${auditId}`, `> 生成时间: ${now}`, `> 统计周期: ${period.start} ~ ${period.end}`, '', `## 总体状态: ${progress.status}`, '', '## 扫描摘要（本次审查覆盖范围）', '', '| 项目 | 数量 |', '|---|---|', `| TaskPacks | ${scan.pending.taskpacks} |`, `| Specs | ${scan.pending.specs} |`, `| Commits | ${scan.pending.commits} |`, `| Reviews | ${scan.existing_reviews} |`, '', '## 扫描到的对象（样例，最多20条）', '', '### TaskPacks', '', fmtList(samples.taskpacks), '', '### Specs', '', fmtList(samples.specs), '', '### Commits', '', fmtList(samples.commits), '', '### Reviews', '', fmtList(samples.reviews), '', '## 关键指标', '', '| 指标 | 数值 |', '|---|---|', `| 周期内任务数 | ${progress.metrics.tasks_in_period} |`, `| 周期内规格数 | ${progress.metrics.specs_in_period} |`, `| 周期内提交数 | ${progress.metrics.commits_in_period} |`, `| 完成审查数 | ${progress.metrics.reviews_completed} |`, `| 通过审查数 | ${progress.metrics.reviews_passed} |`, `| 综合通过率 | ${progress.metrics.overall_pass_rate} |`, `| 代码审查均分 | ${progress.metrics.code_review_avg_score} |`, `| 设计审查均分 | ${progress.metrics.design_review_avg_score} |`, '', '## 审查明细', '', '### 代码审查', `- 数量: ${progress.breakdown.code_review.count}`, `- 通过: ${progress.breakdown.code_review.passed}`, '', '### 设计审查', `- 数量: ${progress.breakdown.design_review.count}`, `- 通过: ${progress.breakdown.design_review.passed}`, '', '### QA签字', `- 数量: ${progress.breakdown.qa_signoff.count}`, `- 通过: ${progress.breakdown.qa_signoff.passed}`, '', '## 决策建议', '', `**决策**: ${rec.decision}`, '', '### 建议', fmtList(rec.recommendations), '', '### 下一步', fmtList(rec.next_steps), '' ].join('\n'); return { content: md }; })()

nodes.name: 构建问题报告 Markdown
nodes.expression:
(function() { const auditId = nodes.intake.output.audit_id; const period = nodes.intake.output.period; const now = new Date().toISOString(); const report = nodes.generate_issue_report.output; const fmtStrList = (items, emptyText = '- （无）') => { const list = (items || []).map(s => String(s).trim()).filter(Boolean).slice(0, 20); if (!list.length) return emptyText; return list.map(s => '- ' + s).join('
'); }; const fmtIssueObjs = (items, emptyText) => { const list = (items || []).slice(0, 20); if (!list.length) return emptyText; return list.map(i => { const src = i?.source ? String(i.source) : 'unknown'; const tgt = i?.target ? String(i.target) : 'unknown'; const cnt = Array.isArray(i?.issues) ? i.issues.length : 0; return `- ${src} -> ${tgt}（${cnt}项）`; }).join('
'); }; const blockersMd = (report.summary.blocker_count > 0) ? fmtIssueObjs(report.blockers, '- （无）') : '无阻塞问题 ✅'; const warningsMd = (report.summary.warning_count > 0) ? fmtIssueObjs(report.warnings, '- （无）') : '无警告问题 ✅'; const priorityMd = (report.priority_actions || []).map((s, idx) => `${idx + 1}. ${s}`).join('
') || '1. 维持现状'; const md = [ '# 问题报告', '', `> 审核ID: ${auditId}`, `> 生成时间: ${now}`, `> 统计周期: ${period.start} ~ ${period.end}`, '', '## 问题摘要', '', '| 类型 | 数量 |', '|---|---|', `| 🔴 阻塞问题 | ${report.summary.blocker_count} |`, `| 🟡 警告问题 | ${report.summary.warning_count} |`, `| 🟢 改进建议 | ${report.summary.improvement_count} |`, '', '## 阻塞问题（Blockers）', '', blockersMd, '', '## 警告问题（Warnings）', '', warningsMd, '', '## 改进建议（最多20条）', '', fmtStrList(report.improvements), '', '## 优先行动', '', priorityMd, '' ].join('
'); return { content: md }; })()
